- Procurement: you mentioned a standard vendor security questionnaire and a short procurement checklist.

What we can share now:
1) Redacted SOC 2 attestation (we can share under NDA)
2) High-level pen-test summary and our vuln management SLAs
3) A filled vendor questionnaire draft if you send the template

Thanks Stephanie — great demo. I attached our vendor security questionnaire (MedSci_Risk_RQ_2026.xlsx). A few quick answers:

- SOC 2: We require vendors to have SOC 2 Type II or provide a remediation plan and timeline if transitioning.
- HIPAA/GDPR: For PHI-adjacent work we need evidence of technical and administrative safeguards and a data flow diagram (if PHI will be transmitted).
- Pen test: We prefer a redacted report plus a summary of critical/high findings and proof of remediation tracking (tickets or changelogs).

Please send the SOC 2 and pen-test materials to the secure share link once you're ready. We can start procurement once we have the vendor questionnaire filled and the redacted artifacts.

I attached the questionnaire for Marcus to fill out.

Ella Thompson
Senior Information Security Manager
MedSci Therapeutics
ella.thompson@medsci.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Ella Thompson <ella.thompson@medsci.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-22T08:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + security info request

Hi Ella —

Thanks for the questionnaire, I started filling the sheet (will upload back shortly). High-level responses below (summaries; I can attach redacted artifacts once the NDA is confirmed):

SOC 2 / Compliance
- SOC 2 Type II: Redwood maintains a SOC 2 Type II attestation (period ending 2025-09-30). Full attestation is available under NDA; we can provide a redacted PDF.
- HIPAA: We support covered workflows via BAA and technical controls (encryption at rest/in transit, access controls, audit logs).

Penetration testing / vulnerability management
- Pen test cadence: Annual third-party pen test + targeted tests for major releases (we also run quarterly internal app tests).
- Redaction: We provide an executive summary and a redacted report for procurement. Example filename: Redwood_PenTest_Summary_2026_redacted.pdf
- Triage & remediation SLAs (suggested):
  - Critical (RCE/data exfil): initial response ack within 4 hours; remediation or mitigation plan within 48 hours.
  - High: ack within 24 hours; fix or mitigation within 5 business days.
  - Medium: ack within 3 business days; remediation tracked with target 30 days.
  - Low: tracked in backlog with periodic review.
- Disclosure policy: coordinated vulnerability disclosure — we notify affected customers and provide remediation timelines; public disclosure only after mutual agreement.

Evidence & tracking
- We can provide Jira MR/Ticket snapshots and a CSV export of remediation tracking for the last 12 months.
- KMS: Customer keys supported via BYOK integrations with major cloud KMS providers; we can provide an architecture diagram.

Next steps I propose:
1) Stephanie: I'll upload the redacted SOC2 + pen-test summary to your secure share once we have NDA confirmation.
2) Ella: If you can mark the questionnaire fields you want us to prioritize, we'll return the completed sheet + artifacts in one bundle.

Happy to hop on a 20-min technical call if you want to walk through specifics.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

Attachment references: Redwood_PenTest_Summary_2026_redacted.pdf (will share after NDA)
